$comment: The toolchain the CI legs are pinned to, in one place. tools/ci/check_toolchain_versions.py fails when a workflow, an action or an install script carries a different value (docs/ci.md). The shared setup actions of icl-common-infra read qt, aqtsource, cmake, gcc and llvm from here. The vcpkg baseline stays in vcpkg.json. msvc_toolset is what windows-2025-vs2026 carries (VCToolsVersion 14.51.36231 in the CI log of 2026-10-27) and has no other home.
